WARNING: This AUO Version is no longer receiving major updates but small updates as we focus on a new version with better systems and gameplay mechanic. Your data in this version will not be fully transferred to the new Version, play at your own risk.

ACG Operation also known as AUO or ACG is a combat game where you unlock characters via quests. This game includes franchises like Arknights, Punishing Gray Raven, Library of Ruina, Limbus Company, Blue Archive, Blazblue and more!

Unlock new abilities and beat up your opps with amazing abilities!

Basic Input:
M1 - Normal Attacks
F - Block
P - Pose (Aura farm)
